messages.author: bc55e9a3472981da
messages.subject: pcountOpen, fix recruitment rate
parts:
Hi all,

I am using pcountOpen(), and I have three primary periods. 
I would like to fix the recruitment rate between period 2 and 3 to zero. 

Is there any way to do this?

Best, Sonja

messages.author: 247b990d236a7af6
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] pcountOpen, fix recruitment rate
parts:
There might be some trick to do so but it appears that when using pcountOpen the choices are (1) setting all recruitment rates to zero (using the option fix="gamma") or (2) allowing that recruitment rate between period 2 and 3 to be estimated and test to see if that is zero.

The more direct way is to construct the likelihood function with that recruitment rate set to zero.  If your proposed set of models are not too complicated (and the data is "nice"), then writing code to duplicate pcountOpen for those models is certainly possible.  To state the obvious there's a lot of quality assurance resulting in stability of the pcountOpen code which would not necessarily be the case for any home-grown versions.  But if such a model is desired, then that's what you'd likely need to do.

So....how complicated are the models you're considering?

Jim
